points.description: First advantage stated precisely, matching a model answer advantage: superior/high-quality products manufactured with minimal human intervention and in less time using smart machines and advanced technologies. Must include quality AND reduced human intervention/time (smart machines/advanced technology).
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only one clearly correct part is stated precisely (e.g. superior quality products, or less time/minimal human intervention) without the other.

points.description: Second advantage stated precisely, matching a model answer advantage: manufacturing processes are highly efficient in time and cost per piece, with less wasted raw material. Must name efficiency in both time and cost per piece (and/or reduced raw material waste).
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only one part is stated precisely (e.g. lower cost per piece, or less raw material waste) without the efficiency in time/cost link.

rubric.notes: Full marks only if two distinct advantages are given, each matching the model answer's content precisely (quality/minimal human intervention/less time; efficiency in time and cost per piece/less material waste). Part marks only where more than half of an advantage is precisely stated. Vague claims ('better', 'modern', 'automation') or wrong/duplicate advantages earn nothing for that point; a wrong extra advantage in place of a required one costs that point.
